title: Cancel a reply: it stops at once and nothing is left running
evidence: Finding: the oracle has no cancel. 0.79.3: in all four turn traces the composer's round button says Send message, then Start voice chat for the whole reply; it never becomes a Stop. 1.0.3, 2026-11-14 (scripts/oracle/cancel.mjs, parity/oracle/cancel.json): through a 53 s reply no stop or cancel label showed and the reply landed whole; Escape closes the details panel. So no Stop is built: there is nothing to copy. The plumbing works, checked live 2026-11-13: POST /v1/chat/sessions/:id/interrupt stops a streaming reply in under 1 s, the partial text is stored, the host has no child process left; Barkpark #25811 ends the stopped turn as turn_completed/interrupted. Needs the owner's decision: drop J05 from phase 1 (the oracle has no cancel), or allow a Stop of our own design, which breaks 1:1 (decision 0005).
